scripts.dev: node scripts/with-root-env.mjs pnpm exec turbo dev
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/with-root-env.mjs uv run --project services/backend python -m second_brain.api
scripts.dev:worker: node scripts/with-root-env.mjs uv run --project services/backend python -m second_brain.worker
scripts.lint: pnpm exec turbo lint && pnpm exec prettier --check .
scripts.test: pnpm exec turbo test && node --test scripts/check-env-layout.test.mjs && node scripts/check-database-types.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -v
scripts.db:types: pnpm exec supabase gen types typescript --local > apps/frontend/src/lib/database.types.ts
scripts.build: node scripts/with-root-env.mjs pnpm exec turbo build
